title: Grilled Polenta with Portobello, Halloumi and Grana Padano
subtitle: with sauteed wild mushrooms
description: Cheesy polenta set in a tray, cut into squares and chargrilled, topped with sauteed portobello and wild mushrooms, seared halloumi and Grana Padano.

steps.text: Bring the water to the boil in a large heavy pot, add the salt and stir to dissolve. Add the polenta in a thin, steady stream, whisking so no lumps form. Stir for 2 minutes until it starts to thicken and boil. Reduce the heat and cook for half an hour, stirring occasionally, until the polenta is firm and pulls away from the sides of the pot. Turn off the heat, add 1 cup (about 100 g) of the Grana Padano and the diced butter and stir to melt.
Spread the polenta in a greased 20 x 30 cm tray and leave for half an hour until firm.

Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a pan and fry the chopped onion until lightly golden. Add both types of mushrooms, season with salt and pepper and fry over medium heat for about 5 minutes until soft. Remove from the heat and stir in the parsley.

Cut the polenta into squares of your preferred size and grill in a griddle pan (or the oven grill) for 3 to 4 minutes each side, until a hard, browned crust forms. Transfer to a plate. Fry the halloumi cubes in a little olive oil in a pan.
Place the polenta squares on serving plates, top with the mushrooms, halloumi and the remaining Grana Padano, drizzle with 3 tbsp olive oil and serve.
